note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Screens that mix a terminal and a portal carry the second half in also[] (when = before/after the main part). Scenes read MG_LAB_ADMIN_UPN / MG_LAB_DOMAIN (set by prepare, derived from the signed-in labadmin).
prepare: Connect-MgGraph -Scopes User.Read -NoWelcome  # owner signs in (browser); only to read the labadmin address
# the two groups (idempotent): Priority Accounts (labadmin, riley) and All Staff (labadmin, alex, sam, riley; Jordan and Taylor deliberately left out)

function Add-LabGroup($name, $alias, $members) { if (-not (Get-DistributionGroup -Identity "$alias@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { New-DistributionGroup -Name $name -Alias $alias -Type Security -PrimarySmtpAddress "$alias@$env:MG_LAB_DOMAIN" -Members $members | Out-Null } }
# an antivirus-excluded folder for EICAR.TXT must exist; the owner sets MG_EICAR_DIR once (User environment variable)
if (-not $env:MG_EICAR_DIR -or -not (Test-Path $env:MG_EICAR_DIR)) { throw 'Set MG_EICAR_DIR to a folder that is excluded from antivirus scanning before recording.' }

steps: Defender portal > Email & collaboration > Policies & rules > Threat policies > Preset security policies
Standard protection and Strict protection are both on; open Manage protection settings to show the recipients as in the file

screens.name: eicar
steps: (EICAR.TXT is created by the per-screen prepare in the antivirus-excluded folder, 68 bytes)
As alex.demo: New message to sam.demo (internal), subject 'Test attachment', attach EICAR.TXT from the excluded folder, Send
As sam.demo: Inbox: the message is not there
Run the hunting commands in the terminal (see also[]); optional: Defender portal > Email & collaboration > Review > Quarantine shows the message
mask: file path of the excluded folder

screens.name: simulation
screens.account: labadmin; alex.demo and sam.demo in their own profiles
steps: Email & collaboration > Attack simulation training > Simulations > Launch a simulation
Technique: Credential Harvest; payload: a Microsoft-provided (global) payload; target users alex.demo, sam.demo, jordan.demo, taylor.demo; assign the recommended training; launch now, short duration
As alex.demo: open the simulation message, click the link, type a made-up value on the simulated page (never a real secret)
As sam.demo: Report > Report phishing. Jordan and Taylor do nothing
When results show: portal simulation report next to the terminal output (see also[])

teardown: Disable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule -Identity 'Standard Preset Security Policy' -Confirm:$false; Disable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule -Identity 'Standard Preset Security Policy' -Confirm:$false; Disable-EOPProtectionPolicyRule -Identity 'Strict Preset Security Policy' -Confirm:$false; Disable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule -Identity 'Strict Preset Security Policy' -Confirm:$false   # or keep the presets, they are Microsoft's recommendation
# by hand: release or delete the quarantined EICAR message (Defender portal > Quarantine); remove any training assigned by the simulation
needs: manual:turn on Standard (Domains = lab domain AND Groups = All Staff) and Strict (Groups = Priority Accounts) presets in the Defender portal, then Disable-ATPProtectionPolicyRule on the Strict rule, before screen audit-before
wait:hunting data for the eicar screen and simulation results can take a while
